description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transformation that renders script tags at the footer of a web page, specifically collecting external script links from the request context used in the OfBiz framework.

classes.name: ScriptTagsFooterTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel that injects script tags into the footer of a web page by retrieving script link URLs from the request context.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that writes script tags to the output when closed, based on script links obtained from the request object.
